name: troth
tagline: An AI partner whose memory lives on your machine, not the vendor's
description: troth is an AI companion concept where the memory stays on your machine rather than on a vendor's servers. Instead of a cloud-bound assistant that forgets context between sessions and stores your data elsewhere, troth keeps your shared history local and private. It is an early, personal/indie project that speaks to the broader desire for AI relationships that respect data ownership.
highlights: AI companion with memory stored on your machine, not the vendor's
Local-first approach keeps shared history private
A reaction to cloud-bound assistants that own your data
Early indie project with a strong data-ownership stance
curatorNote: Data ownership is the quiet tension behind every cloud AI assistant. troth's premise — memory stays on your machine — is a meaningful stance worth keeping an eye on.
